title: rsna-knee-2nd-place-models
subtitle: Trained weights of the six members of the RSNA Knee 2nd place solution
description: Weights of all six blend members, one folder per member: crop-convnext, lateral-effnet, window-convnext and window-effnet (3 seeds each, `seed-N.pt`), and Matthew Liew's mil-reader (5 seeds plus `side-model.pt`) and pf-specialist (3 seeds). The sha256 of every file is pinned in the code dataset (the member configs and `configs/blend.json`).
